accepted.reason: A methodology-rich AWS benchmark demonstrates recent live, end-to-end autonomous exploitation and publishes material negative evidence: two benchmark shortcuts and two target outages. The result supports a restrained signal about agent capability and the unresolved boundary between exploit success and safe operation. The 15 October source was discovered after the prior research cutoff and was evaluated in this run.

Actionable product-security notices, but the affected embedded-software vulnerabilities do not establish a broader AI, agent, cloud-infrastructure, or enterprise-governance signal for this publication.

rejected.reason: Vendor and community launch material surfaced during the window, but no item combined independent evidence, clear enterprise consequence, and sufficient methodology to displace the accepted benchmark story.
